reviews.nonblocking_documentation_note: The reproduction README says the ASAP test password is read from the source README; the builder actually embeds the publicly documented password. It can be described as verified from the frozen README for exact wording.
reviews.review_scope_limits: This review checked integration and reproducibility interfaces. It did not rerun root's already-passing full validations or train models. Final CAMELS-GB counts and release checksum verification remain root integration steps.

reviews.scope: H2 code, candidate metadata, source rights documents, five independently sampled source-backed candidate records; no full raw-population rerun

checks.temporal_indexing: Calendar month-end d, histories d-7 through d-1 inclusive, target d+1; source row references are correct 1-based data rows.
checks.availability_lag: Latest daily record is d-1, so a 09:00-to-09:00 daily aggregation ends during day d and before origin end of d. No d/d+1 hydrometeorological measurements enter input.
checks.label_units: Raw discharge_spec used without conversion. Official supporting RTF Table 1 identifies catchment specific discharge in mm day^-1.
checks.input_leakage: Only four topographic/location static fields and past precipitation, PET, temperature, discharge; no q_mean, runoff ratio, flow quantiles or full-period climate summaries.
checks.rights: Official catalogue explicitly specifies OGL; required UKCEH attribution, all four listed copyright statements and dataset DOI/author citation are present in metadata.
checks.groups: One catchment per group; no claim of spatial independence. Dates and future time/spatial holdout instructions present.

limitations_already_disclosed: Monthly first-day targets cannot estimate unbiased daily or flood-event performance.
Retrospective revised archive values do not establish real-time operational data availability.
Nearby or nested catchments may remain correlated; hold out basins/spatial regions for spatial generalization.
